limitations: The original directly co-tabulates TG and measured oxygen-index values for the four prepared fabric states in Table 4. These parameters remain unknown, and no optimum or Table 1 yield is transferred to Table 4. The fabric is woven as supported by warp yarns disintegrated from the fabric in section 2.4; weave pattern is unreported. Tensile testing has ten or more replicates, which is not a TG or LOI replicate count. Char temperature remains unknown despite the 800°C scan endpoint. Raw T98/T75/T60 are not converted to mass-loss thresholds. No thermal plots are provided to estimate other metrics. Dyed-row processing is separate from subsequent durability/colorfastness tests; no post-durability TG–LOI state is created. Related meta-aramid dyeing publications use a different polymer isomer and require separate original evidence; no values are transferred.
pairing_evidence: The same Table 4 row explicitly contains both DTGA peak, char and measured LOI for Untreated aramid fabric; section 3.3 independently discusses these same prepared states. Unknown optimization settings are not split into extra states.
